Then I'll be expecting the best of the best!

372.EN: (Oh no, I got sweet-talked! The pressure is on...!)

373.EN: Speak whatever you desire. Nothing can stump my dear disciple!

376.EN:
When it comes to coffee,
I think aroma is the most important.

377.EN: I want coffee that smells amazing, and sweet too to boot!

378.EN:
(So I'm limited to aromatic ingredients.
That sounds a little tricky.)

379.EN: (I'll try using ingredients that both smell nice and taste sweet!)

380.EN: ...Mmmm! Any coffee you make is just so delicious!

381.EN: ...Yet the thirst deep in your soul does not seem to have been quenched.

382.EN:
I thought I'd give you a special present
if you could get my request right...

383.EN:
But that'll have to wait another day!
Thanks for the coffee, Mr. Familiar!

384.EN:
What a wonderful smell...!
I'm almost full just from taking a whiff of the cup!

385.EN:
"Coffee, chocolate, and cinnamon...
They're all very aromatic ingredients."

386.EN:
You're right! And it's so nice and sweet,
all the fatigue from my part-time job is melting away...!

387.EN:
The classics are ultimately the most powerful of them all.
An impressive display of returning to your roots, my familiar.

388.EN:
That's true. The cinammon doesn't clump up or anything,
so it goes down so easily too. I can feel your attention to detail.

389.EN: Impressive, Mr. Familiar! You've gotten even better since last time!

390.EN: I'll have to give you something special as thanks...

392.EN: Heh heh heh... Don't you want to see me in a cute little maid dress?

393.EN: ...I'm joking. I just want to try working here with you and Favna!

394.EN:
An alliance between the Wandering Elysium
of the Underworld and the Kingdom of Roses...!
Once this alliance is formed, no one shall stand in our way!

395.EN: "Thank you, Rin-san. Welcome to Fuwa Fuwa!"

396.EN: Thank you, thank you! I'll do my best!

397.EN: Rin will now work for you!

398.EN: "I know it's a bit late, but there's something I want to give you."

400.EN:
"I ordered a special custom-made apron for you.
I hope you can keep being a maid with a smile on your face."

401.EN: Wow...! It's so cute, and with the frilly lace decorations too!

402.EN: It looks a little like the apron that maid wore back then...

405.EN: When I was little, my oshi died.

407.EN: I-I'm sorry. But this has to do with maids, I promise.

408.EN:
I was in such shock at the death of my favorite character,
I couldn't even leave the bed for days...

409.EN:
My parents were worried about me at first, but when they found out
I'd been secretly watching late-night anime, they got mad at me.

410.EN:
They said, "What's the point in getting worked up over something that's not real?"
...That was the first time I ever had a huge fight with my parents,
and then in a fit of anger, I ran out of the house.

411.EN:
(Shiro's usually so friendly and polite... She must have felt really betrayed
when her feelings were completely shut down by her parents.)

412.EN:
Eventually it started to get dark, and I got hungry,
but going home would be too awkward...

413.EN: And then, a maid came up to talk to me.

414.EN:
She didn't say anything more and brought me to her maid cafe,
and even served me a nice, warm drink.

415.EN:
The tears just started flowing... and before I knew it,
I'd told her everything that had happened.

416.EN:
About how my favorite character died, how I fought with my parents,
how I actually wanted to make up with them...

417.EN:
I was just a little kid rambling about myself,
but she listened patiently without shutting me down.

418.EN:
She didn't treat me like a little kid either, and called me "my lady"...
She even treated me to slightly firm custard pudding.

419.EN:
I couldn't help but ask her why she was
doing so much for me, and she said...

420.EN: "We want our lady to smile too."

421.EN:
"Just like how your favorite characters cheer you up,
we're happy thanks to our masters and ladies."

422.EN: "So that's why you like maids so much."

423.EN:
Yes! I want to make our customers smile,
just like how that maid cheered me up!

424.EN:
After all that, I was able to make up with my parents...
And even my oshi, who I thought had died, actually ended up being alive in the end!

425.EN:
So even if things get tough, I think I can overcome anything
as long as I can support someone else.

426.EN:
What a heartfelt gift... With this apron,
I think I can overcome any problems I face with a smile!

429.EN: Manager, there's... one more thing I want. Is that okay?

431.EN:
I want to drink your coffee again, Manager.
The coffee you made when we first met... the coffee of my memories.

432.EN: It was a pretty long time ago, so maybe you've forgotten?

433.EN: Try to remember... the first time we met.

434.EN:
That's right, the Fuwa Fuwa Special!
It's such a familiar flavor, but that's why it calms me down.

435.EN: And I think it's even tastier than the first time you made this for me.

436.EN: {0}-san, your coffee is the warmest coffee in the world!

437.EN: "I know it's a bit late, but I have a present for you, Miyu."

438.EN: "It's a bread maker. I hope you can use it to make brand new dishes."

439.EN:
Wait, for real?! I've wanted this for ages!
Are you a mind reader, Manager?!

440.EN: ...Wait, maybe you are. We're dating, after all! ♪

442.EN: Sorry, sorry. I'll make you tasty freshly baked bread every morning to make up for it!

443.EN: "That would be great, but you really don't have to."

444.EN:
C'mon, we're dating! This much is nothing, really!
Besides, you make really good coffee for me too!

445.EN: "That's fair then! All right, I'll make some coffee right away."

446.EN:
Oh, then I wanna try the first thing you ever made when you came here.
That coffee that represents Fuwa Fuwa itself!

447.EN: Hmm, this is good too, but like... I think I'm in the mood for something else.

448.EN:
I heard all about the first time you made coffee from Shiro.
C'mon, try to remember what you made!

449.EN: This is it! The Fuwa Fuwa Special! I'm a huge fan too! ♪

450.EN:
I feel like you've gotten a lot better at making coffee, too!
It's so delicious, and... so warm.

451.EN: ...It's like I can feel your love, {0}-san.

452.EN: "Oh right, I almost forgot. I want you to have this."

453.EN: Are these earrings? They're so beautiful...!

454.EN: "Really? I'm sorry I couldn't buy anything but the cheapest ones in the store..."

455.EN:
What are you saying? These magic stones have been infused with your mana and love.
They are more beautiful than any other precious stone.

456.EN: "Thanks. If you're happy, I'm happy too."

457.EN:
Let us perform another ritual.
Use your Holy Grail to fill the magic stones with warmth.

458.EN:
Please, Manager. Make me the coffee that represents the
Wandering Elysium of the Underworld—Fuwa Fuwa!

459.EN:
Oh, this isn't what I meant.
Have you forgotten the first drink you made?

460.EN:
You once made a coffee named after Fuwa Fuwa itself, have you not?
Think back on that memory and recall it.

461.EN:
Yes, the Fuwa Fuwa Special... No other drink,
no matter how extravagant, can compare to your heartfelt effort.

462.EN:
It tastes even better than before, and warmer as well...
There is nothing more you can learn from me.

463.EN: Even from now on, you are the only one I put my utmost trust in, {0}-san.

464.EN: "I know it's a bit late, but I have a present for you, Honoka."

465.EN: Aw, it's a glass pen! It's so lovely, I can't help but stare at it~

466.EN:
"You're always so hard at work both in the office
and on your drawing board. I hope this pen will help you relax once in a while."

467.EN: Thanks! I'll try drawin' with this for my next con.

468.EN: ...Oh, right! You'll be the first to get a brand new hand-drawn illustration from me! ♪

469.EN: "Really? Then sign it too! I'll put it up in the cafe."

470.EN: Huhhh?! That's a li'l TOO embarrassin'...

471.EN: "Don't say that. I want to be become your very first fan, for real this time."

472.EN: If ya say so... Then sure, but only if ya treat me to a cup of coffee.

473.EN: Gimme Fuwa Fuwa's signature drink, please!

474.EN: I'll gladly take this too, but... This ain't the signature drink at all, is it?

475.EN: Try to remember the very first drink ya made here in Fuwa Fuwa.

476.EN: I've been waitin' for this! The Fuwa Fuwa Special!

477.EN: ...Whew. Drinkin' your coffee really calms me down.

478.EN:
And you're gettin' better and better at makin' it.
It's almost too good to serve to customers~

479.EN: I hope you'll make me coffee every mornin' someday, {0}.
